import scanpy as sc
import omicverse as ov
import os

# ========= 参数 =========
from pathlib import Path
import os

import scanpy as sc
import anndata as ad
study = "PRJNA562645_1"
data_dir = Path("/home/anzhen_vhd/scRNAseq_Guo/Data/PRJNA562645_1")

batch_key = "batch"
n_HVGs = 3000
mode = "shiftlog|pearson"
SAMPLE_KEY = "batch"
doublets_method = "scrublet"
max_value = 10
n_pcs = 50
recompute_scaled = True
recompute_pca = True

# ========= 参数 =========
def find_10x_dir(sample_root: Path) -> Path:
    """
    自动定位10x mtx目录。
    当前 PRJNA562645_1 的结构里，sample_root 本身就是 10x 目录；
    同时保留对常见 10x 子目录结构的兼容。
    """
    candidates = [
        sample_root,
        sample_root / "filtered_feature_bc_matrix",
        sample_root / "outs" / "filtered_feature_bc_matrix",
        sample_root / "raw_feature_bc_matrix",
        sample_root / "outs" / "raw_feature_bc_matrix",
    ]
    for c in candidates:
        if c.is_dir() and ((c / "matrix.mtx").exists() or (c / "matrix.mtx.gz").exists()):
            return c

    hits = list(sample_root.rglob("matrix.mtx")) + list(sample_root.rglob("matrix.mtx.gz"))
    if hits:
        return hits[0].parent

    raise FileNotFoundError(f"Cannot find 10x mtx dir under: {sample_root}")


# 1) 获取样本列表：所有一级子目录都视为 sample
samples = sorted([p.name for p in data_dir.iterdir() if p.is_dir()])
print(f"[{study}] Found {len(samples)} samples:")
print(samples)

adatas = []
for sample in samples:
    sample_root = data_dir / sample
    mtx_dir = find_10x_dir(sample_root)

    # 这里 sample 本身就是样本ID，例如 SRX6862541
    sample_id = sample

    a = sc.read_10x_mtx(
        mtx_dir,
        var_names="gene_symbols",
        make_unique=True,
        cache=False
    )

    # 2) 统一 obs 字段
    a.obs["study"] = study
    a.obs["sample"] = sample          # 原始文件夹名
    a.obs["sample_id"] = sample_id    # 样本ID
    a.obs["batch"] = sample_id        # batch 直接用文件夹名

    # 3) 统一细胞命名规则：全局唯一且可追溯
    a.obs_names = [f"{study}|{sample_id}|{bc}" for bc in a.obs_names]
    a.obs_names_make_unique()

    # 4) 基因名唯一化
    a.var_names_make_unique()

    # 可选：记录来源路径
    a.uns["source_mtx_dir"] = str(mtx_dir)

    adatas.append(a)

# 5) 合并
adata = ad.concat(
    adatas,
    axis=0,
    join="outer",
    fill_value=0,
    merge="same"
)

# 6) 统一类型
for col in ["study", "sample", "sample_id", "batch"]:
    adata.obs[col] = adata.obs[col].astype("category")

print(adata)
print("cells per sample:\n", adata.obs["sample"].value_counts())
print("cells per sample_id:\n", adata.obs["sample_id"].value_counts())
print("batch unique:", adata.obs["batch"].unique())

print("After concat:")
print("PPBP in var_names:", "PPBP" in adata.var_names)
print("COL2A1 in var_names:", "COL2A1" in adata.var_names)
print("n_vars:", adata.n_vars)
print("X max:", adata.X.max())

# 计算并以箱线图形式展示表达量最高的20个基因
sc.pl.highest_expr_genes(adata, n_top=20, save="highest_expr_genes.pdf")

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import scanpy as sc
import omicverse as ov
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

ov.settings.cpu_init()

# 论文 QC 参数（细胞级）
MIN_GENES, MAX_GENES = 500, 8000
MIN_COUNTS, MAX_COUNTS = 1000, 100000
MAX_MT_FRAC = 0.20
MAX_RIBO_FRAC = 0.30

# 论文样本级过滤：<50 高质量细胞的样本剔除
MIN_CELLS_PER_SAMPLE = 50

sc.set_figure_params(dpi=300, facecolor="white", vector_friendly=True)

# =========================
# 1) QC 指标计算
# =========================
adata.var["mt"] = adata.var_names.str.upper().str.startswith("MT-")
adata.var["ribo"] = adata.var_names.str.upper().str.startswith(("RPS", "RPL"))
adata.var["hb"] = adata.var_names.str.contains("^HB[^(P)]", regex=True)

sc.pp.calculate_qc_metrics(
    adata, qc_vars=["mt", "ribo", "hb"], inplace=True, percent_top=[20], log1p=False
)

n_raw = adata.n_obs
print(f"[{study}] 原始细胞数: {n_raw:,}")

# =========================
# 2) 可视化
# =========================
def plot_qc_dashboard(ad, stage="Pre"):
    fig, axs = plt.subplots(1, 4, figsize=(18, 4))
    metrics = ["total_counts", "n_genes_by_counts", "pct_counts_mt", "pct_counts_ribo"]
    for i, key in enumerate(metrics):
        sns.violinplot(
            data=ad.obs, y=key, x=SAMPLE_KEY, ax=axs[i],
            inner="quartile", cut=0
        )
        axs[i].set_title(key)
        axs[i].tick_params(axis="x", rotation=90)
    plt.suptitle(f"{study} - {stage}-QC Metrics Distribution", fontsize=16)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(f"{study}.{stage}_QC_Violin.pdf")
    plt.show()

    fig, axs = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4))
    sc.pl.scatter(ad, x="total_counts", y="pct_counts_mt", ax=axs[0], show=False)
    axs[0].axhline(MAX_MT_FRAC * 100, color="red", linestyle="--")
    axs[0].set_title("Count vs MT%")

    sc.pl.scatter(ad, x="total_counts", y="n_genes_by_counts", ax=axs[1], show=False)
    axs[1].axhline(MIN_GENES, color="red", linestyle="--")
    axs[1].axhline(MAX_GENES, color="red", linestyle="--")
    axs[1].set_title("Count vs Genes")

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(f"{study}.{stage}_QC_Scatter.pdf")
    plt.show()

plot_qc_dashboard(adata, stage="Pre")

# =========================
# 3) Hard QC：只过滤细胞
# =========================
qc_mask = (
    (adata.obs["pct_counts_ribo"] <= MAX_RIBO_FRAC * 100) &
    (adata.obs["n_genes_by_counts"] >= MIN_GENES) &
    (adata.obs["n_genes_by_counts"] <= MAX_GENES) &
    (adata.obs["total_counts"] >= MIN_COUNTS) &
    (adata.obs["total_counts"] <= MAX_COUNTS) &
    (adata.obs["pct_counts_mt"] < MAX_MT_FRAC * 100)
)

before = adata.n_obs
adata = adata[qc_mask].copy()
print(f"[{study}] Hard QC 完成：移除 {before - adata.n_obs:,}，剩余 {adata.n_obs:,}")

# =========================
# 4) Pre-scrublet：删掉 <50 cells 的 batch
# =========================
cells_per_sample = adata.obs[SAMPLE_KEY].value_counts()
bad_samples = cells_per_sample[cells_per_sample < MIN_CELLS_PER_SAMPLE].index

print(f"[{study}] Pre-scrublet drop samples <{MIN_CELLS_PER_SAMPLE} cells: {len(bad_samples)}")
if len(bad_samples) > 0:
    before = adata.n_obs
    adata = adata[~adata.obs[SAMPLE_KEY].isin(bad_samples)].copy()
    print(f"[{study}] Dropped: {before - adata.n_obs:,} cells; remaining {adata.n_obs:,}")

# =========================
# 4.5) ★关键新增：保存“细胞已过 hard QC、但基因仍完整”的全基因备份
# 后续注释时从这里临时取全基因表达；最终保存前也从这里重建最终对象
# =========================
adata_allgenes = adata.copy()
print(f"[{study}] all-gene backup before ov.pp.qc: {adata_allgenes.shape}")

# =========================
# 5) omicverse：保留 scrublet 并删除 doublet
#    说明：Hard QC 已做完，所以 counts/genes 下限设 0，避免重复过滤。
# =========================
ov_tresh_loose = {
    "mito_perc": MAX_MT_FRAC,
    "nUMIs": 0,
    "detected_genes": 0
}

adata = ov.pp.qc(
    adata,
    tresh=ov_tresh_loose,
    identify_robust=False,
    doublets_method=doublets_method,
    batch_key=SAMPLE_KEY,
    filter_doublets=True
)

print(f"[{study}] omicverse QC(+scrublet + removed doublets) 完成，当前工作对象: {adata.shape}")

# =========================
# 5.5) ★关键新增：用最终保留的细胞名单，同步收缩全基因备份
# adata 继续当工作对象；adata_allgenes 作为后续注释/最终保存的全基因来源
# =========================
keep_cells = adata.obs_names.copy()
adata_allgenes = adata_allgenes[keep_cells].copy()

# 同步 scrublet / doublet 相关结果到全基因备份（后面保存时更方便）
for col in ["doublet_score", "predicted_doublet"]:
    if col in adata.obs.columns:
        adata_allgenes.obs[col] = adata.obs.loc[adata_allgenes.obs_names, col].values

# 如 omicverse 写入了其他你希望保留的 obs 列，也一并同步
extra_obs_cols = [c for c in adata.obs.columns if c not in adata_allgenes.obs.columns]
for col in extra_obs_cols:
    adata_allgenes.obs[col] = adata.obs.loc[adata_allgenes.obs_names, col].values

print(f"[{study}] all-gene backup after scrublet sync: {adata_allgenes.shape}")
print("PPBP in adata_allgenes.var_names:", "PPBP" in adata_allgenes.var_names)
print("COL2A1 in adata_allgenes.var_names:", "COL2A1" in adata_allgenes.var_names)

# =========================
# 6) Post-QC 可视化与总结
# =========================
plot_qc_dashboard(adata, stage="Post")

n_final = adata.n_obs
print(f"\n[{study}] 质控总结:")
print(f"- Hard QC：genes {MIN_GENES}-{MAX_GENES}, counts {MIN_COUNTS}-{MAX_COUNTS}, mt<{MAX_MT_FRAC*100:.0f}%, ribo<{MAX_RIBO_FRAC*100:.0f}%")
print(f"- Pre-scrublet：drop samples <{MIN_CELLS_PER_SAMPLE} cells（论文规则）")
print(f"- Doublet removal：{doublets_method}（omicverse 默认阈值）")
print(f"- 最终剩余细胞: {n_final:,}")
print(f"- 总移除比例: {(n_raw - n_final) / n_raw:.2%}")

print("After concat:")
print("PPBP in var_names:", "PPBP" in adata.var_names)
print("COL2A1 in var_names:", "COL2A1" in adata.var_names)
print("n_vars:", adata.n_vars)

# 0) 在任何归一化/标准化/切HVG之前：保存“全基因 counts”
ov.utils.store_layers(adata, layers="counts")

# 1) 把“全细胞×全基因 counts”永久锁进 raw（非常关键）
#    注意：raw 会保存当前 X/var/obs 的快照；此时 X 仍是原始 counts（如果你一直没改过 X）
adata.raw = adata.copy()

# 2) 预处理：shiftlog + pearson，并在 batch 内选 HVG
#    说明：既然用了 pearson residuals，这里不需要 target_sum
adata = ov.pp.preprocess(
    adata,
    mode=mode,
    n_HVGs=n_HVGs,
    batch_key=batch_key
)

# 3) 切到 HVG 子集用于 PCA/UMAP/聚类（建议 copy）
hvg_col = "highly_variable_features"
assert hvg_col in adata.var.columns, f"未找到 {hvg_col}，请检查 ov.pp.preprocess 是否成功标注 HVG。"

adata = adata[:, adata.var[hvg_col]].copy()

# 4) 打印关键状态
print(f"[{study}] preprocess finished")
print(adata)
print("HVGs:", adata.n_vars)
print("counts layer exists:", "counts" in adata.layers)
print("raw shape (full genes):", adata.raw.shape)

import numpy as np

def check_storage(adata, n_check_genes=5, seed=0):
    print("=== Storage check ===")
    print("Current adata shape:", adata.shape)

    # 1) raw 是否存在
    if adata.raw is None:
        print("❌ adata.raw is None (未保存全基因快照)")
        return
    print("raw shape:", adata.raw.shape)

    # 2) raw 是否比当前基因多（说明确实保留了全基因）
    if adata.raw.shape[1] <= adata.shape[1]:
        print("⚠️ raw genes <= current genes：你可能在保存 raw 之前就切过 HVG")
    else:
        print("✅ raw genes > current genes：raw 保留了更全的基因集")

    # 3) 检查 raw.X 是否像 counts（非负 + 接近整数）
    Xr = adata.raw.X
    # 抽样少量元素避免太大
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    n_cells = min(adata.raw.shape[0], 200)
    n_genes = min(adata.raw.shape[1], 200)

    cell_idx = rng.choice(adata.raw.shape[0], size=n_cells, replace=False)
    gene_idx = rng.choice(adata.raw.shape[1], size=n_genes, replace=False)

    sub = Xr[cell_idx][:, gene_idx]
    if hasattr(sub, "A"):  # sparse
        sub = sub.A

    minv = float(sub.min())
    maxv = float(sub.max())
    frac_negative = float((sub < 0).mean())
    frac_nonint = float((np.abs(sub - np.round(sub)) > 1e-6).mean())

    print(f"raw.X sampled min={minv:.3f}, max={maxv:.3f}, negative_frac={frac_negative:.4f}, nonint_frac={frac_nonint:.4f}")

    if frac_negative == 0 and frac_nonint < 0.01:
        print("✅ raw.X looks like raw counts (non-negative, mostly integers).")
    else:
        print("⚠️ raw.X does NOT look like raw counts. 说明你在保存 raw 之前，X 可能已被 log/pearson 处理过。")

    # 4) 检查 layers['counts'] 当前是否存在
    if "counts" in adata.layers:
        print("counts layer shape:", adata.layers["counts"].shape)
        if adata.layers["counts"].shape[1] == adata.shape[1]:
            print("ℹ️ layers['counts'] 已随 HVG 切片变成 HVG 维度（这是正常行为）。")
    else:
        print("⚠️ layers['counts'] not found.")

    # 5) 随机抽查 raw 中的基因名是否包含当前基因名
    raw_genes = adata.raw.var_names
    cur_genes = adata.var_names
    inter = np.intersect1d(raw_genes, cur_genes)
    print(f"Overlap genes between raw and current: {len(inter):,}/{len(cur_genes):,}")

    if len(inter) == len(cur_genes):
        print("✅ current HVG genes are all present in raw (good).")
    else:
        print("⚠️ some current genes not found in raw (不常见，需检查基因名一致性)。")

check_storage(adata)
print("PPBP in raw:", "PPBP" in adata.raw.var_names)
print("COL2A1 in raw:", "COL2A1" in adata.raw.var_names)
#PCA
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import omicverse as ov
def safe_max(mat):
    """Return max for dense/sparse/cupy-like matrices."""
    try:
        m = mat.max()
        return float(m) if np.isscalar(m) else float(np.asarray(m).max())
    except Exception:
        return float(np.asarray(mat).max())

# 1) Scale -> layers["scaled"]
print(f"[{study}] X max before scale: {safe_max(adata.X)}")

if ("scaled" not in adata.layers) or recompute_scaled:
    ov.pp.scale(adata, max_value=max_value)  # writes to layers["scaled"] (and may update X)

assert "scaled" in adata.layers, "layers['scaled'] not found. scale() may have failed."

print(f"[{study}] X max after  scale: {safe_max(adata.X)}")
print(f"[{study}] scaled max: {safe_max(adata.layers['scaled'])}")
print(f"[{study}] layers: {list(adata.layers.keys())}")

# 2) PCA on scaled layer
has_pca = ("X_pca" in adata.obsm) or ("scaled|original|X_pca" in adata.obsm)
if (not has_pca) or recompute_pca:
    ov.pp.pca(adata, layer="scaled", n_pcs=n_pcs)
#PCA_UMAP
ov.settings.cpu_init()
ov.pp.neighbors(adata, n_neighbors=30, n_pcs=50,
               use_rep='X_pca')
#Harmony
ov.settings.cpu_init()
adata_harmony = ov.single.batch_correction(
    adata,
    batch_key='batch',
    max_iter_harmony=20,
    methods='harmony',
    n_pcs=50
)

ov.settings.cpu_init()
ov.pp.neighbors(adata, n_neighbors=15, n_pcs=30,
               use_rep='X_pca_harmony')
ov.pp.umap(adata)
adata.obsm['X_umap_harmony']=adata.obsm['X_umap']
ov.utils.embedding(adata,
    basis='X_umap_harmony', frameon='small',
    color=['batch'], show=False)

#Leiden
ov.settings.cpu_init()
ov.utils.cluster(adata, key_added="leiden_res2", resolution=2)
ov.utils.cluster(adata, key_added="leiden_res3", resolution=3)
ov.utils.embedding(adata,
    basis='X_umap_harmony',
    color=["leiden_res2", "leiden_res3"],
    title=['leiden_res2', 'Resolution3'],
    palette=ov.palette()[12:],
    show=False,
    frameon='small',
)

import scanpy as sc
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy import sparse
from collections import OrderedDict

# ========= 1. 选择分群列 =========
cluster_key = "leiden_res2"

if cluster_key not in adata.obs.columns:
    raise ValueError(f"{cluster_key} 不在 adata.obs.columns 中，请检查列名。")

# ========= 2. 从“全基因备份”构建用于画图的新对象 =========
# 注意：这里不替换当前 adata，只临时取回同一批细胞的全基因矩阵
adata_plot = adata_allgenes[adata.obs_names].copy()

# 把 cluster 信息同步过去
adata_plot.obs[cluster_key] = adata.obs.loc[adata_plot.obs_names, cluster_key].values
adata_plot.obs[cluster_key] = adata_plot.obs[cluster_key].astype("category")

# ========= 3. 检查 adata_plot 是否为 counts，并做 normalize/log1p =========
Xraw = adata_plot.X
vals = Xraw.data if sparse.issparse(Xraw) else Xraw.ravel()

print("===== FULL-GENE matrix summary =====")
print("n_nonzero:", len(vals))
print("min:", vals.min() if len(vals) > 0 else "NA")
print("max:", vals.max() if len(vals) > 0 else "NA")

if len(vals) > 0:
    is_integer_like = np.allclose(vals[:min(100000, len(vals))], np.round(vals[:min(100000, len(vals))]))
else:
    is_integer_like = False

print("integer_like(first up to 100000 nonzero values):", is_integer_like)

if len(vals) > 0 and is_integer_like and vals.max() > 50:
    print("adata_plot is count matrix -> normalize_total + log1p")
    sc.pp.normalize_total(adata_plot, target_sum=1e4)
    sc.pp.log1p(adata_plot)
else:
    print("adata_plot seems already normalized/log-transformed -> skip normalization")

# ========= 4. Level 1 marker =========
marker_dict = OrderedDict({
    "Fibroblast": ["LUM","DCN","COL1A1","COL1A2", "FBLN1","THY1","C3","C7"],
    "Fibromyocyte": ["FN1", "LUM","TNFRSF11B","ACTA2","TCF21"],
    "Smooth muscle cell": ["ACTA2","MYH11", "MYL9","TPM2","CALD1","TAGLN",
        "TNFRSF11B", "LUM", "APOE","APOC1","AGT","NOTCH3",
        "PDGFRB", "MFAP4"],
    "Endothelial cell": ["PECAM1","VWF","FABP4","CLDN5","IFI27","ECSCR",
        "DYSF", "CD34", "COL4A1", "COL4A2", "SPARCL1",
        "PLVAP", "MPZL2", "SULF1", "EDN1"],
    "B cell": ["CD79A", "CD79B", "MS4A1","IGKC","CD22","FCER2", ],
    "Plasma cell": ["IGKC","IGHM","IGHA1","IGLC2","IGLC3","JCHAIN"],
    "Natural killer cells": [
        "NKG7", "XCL1", "CTSW","XCL2","CD160","FCGR3A","PRF1", "GNLY"],
    "T cell": [
        "CD2", "TRAC", "CD69","CD3E","CD3D", "CD4", "CD8A", "CD8B", "EOMES", "LAG3" ],
    "Neutrophil": [
        "NAMPT","IFITM2","G0S2","CXCL8","NEAT1","SRGN",
        "AQP9", "SOD2", "IVNS1ABP", "FCGR3A"],
    "Monocyte": [
        "FCN1", "S100A8", "S100A9","S100A12","VCAN","CD52","LYZ","CTSS"
    ],
    "Mast cell": [
        "TPSAB1", "TPSB2","KIT","HDC","CMA1"],
    "Dendritic cell": [
        "CLEC10A", "FCER1A","CD1C","HLA-DRA","HLA-DRB1", 
    ],
    "Macrophage": [
        "C1QA","C1QB","C1QC","CD74","AIF1",
        "CD14","CD68","ITGAM","CSF1R","HLA-DRA","LGALS3"]
})

# ========= 5. 用全基因空间过滤 marker =========
var_names_set = set(adata_plot.var_names)

marker_dict_filtered = OrderedDict()
missing_markers = OrderedDict()

for celltype, genes in marker_dict.items():
    genes_unique = list(dict.fromkeys(genes))
    genes_present = [g for g in genes_unique if g in var_names_set]
    genes_missing = [g for g in genes_unique if g not in var_names_set]

    marker_dict_filtered[celltype] = genes_present
    missing_markers[celltype] = genes_missing

print("\n===== Missing markers in FULL-GENE matrix =====")
for ct, genes in missing_markers.items():
    if len(genes) > 0:
        print(f"{ct}: {genes}")

print("\n===== Markers used for plotting (FULL-GENE matrix) =====")
for ct, genes in marker_dict_filtered.items():
    print(f"{ct} ({len(genes)}): {genes}")

# ========= 6. 画 dotplot =========
sc.pl.dotplot(
    adata_plot,
    var_names=marker_dict_filtered,
    groupby=cluster_key,
    standard_scale="var",
    figsize=(26, 10)
)

cluster_key = "leiden_res2"

cluster2celltype = {
    "0": "Neutrophil",  # ELANE / IFITM2 / IFITM3 / CXCL8 / SRGN / AQP9 明显
    "1": "Neutrophil",  # 中性粒细胞标记持续高表达，典型 Neutrophil
    "2": "Neutrophil",  # ELANE/CXCL8/AQP9 强，伴少量炎症相关基因
    "3": "Neutrophil",  # Neutrophil markers 为主
